established_by_measurement: Interior extraction was already complete before this session. MainShell.fbx carries layer -부산역 with 666537 triangles and is placed in FpsStation.unity with 8 MeshColliders, all non-convex and enabled.

Unity collider probe v2 confirms the Blender audit: rooms with floor and ceiling 2.2 to 6.0m apart exist. Station-owned floor at y=7.0 measures 1992 square metres by transform-ancestry filter, comparable to the audit estimate of 1608.

Connected component decomposition over standable voxels finds component id 192: 1820 square metres, y range 6.1 to 10.9, world X -24 to 74, world Z -91 to -28. This is the 2F concourse and it is one continuous walkable space.
Larger components exist at y 12 to 16 (3161), y 23 to 24 (4175) and y 29.4 to 31.9 (6471). The y 29.4 to 31.9 one has no ceiling in the v2 probe so it is roof surface, not interior.

Flood fill from the receipt spawn on a road reaches only 639 of 1992 station cells at y=7.0, and the reachable part is an isolated block separate from the concourse. The concourse itself is unreachable from that spawn.

zone_method.instructions: How should interior zones be defined on the confirmed 1820 square metre concourse?

criteria.derive_from_source_signals: Derive room boundaries from measurable signals already in the official geometry, such as floor material changes and ceiling height changes, so placement is read out of the source rather than invented
criteria.reuse_mvp_zone_coordinates: Reuse the hardcoded MvpStationZones coordinates and remap them onto the official interior
criteria.author_new_layout_by_judgement: Author a fresh zone layout using architectural judgement about how a station concourse is usually arranged
criteria.defer_until_public_plan_obtained: Do nothing until an actual published floor plan of Busan station 2F is obtained and registered as evidence

spawn_fix.instructions: The concourse is unreachable from the current road spawn. What should be done?

criteria.spawn_inside_concourse: Move the tutorial spawn into the concourse, because a station employee starts a shift inside the building and no road approach is required for this mode
criteria.build_connector_stairs: Author new stairs or ramps to connect the road spawn to the concourse
criteria.leave_unreachable: Leave the spawn as is and accept that the concourse cannot be entered

mvp_zone_reuse.instructions: Given its own comment disclaims measurement, is MvpStationZones a usable wheel here?

criteria.not_usable_as_placement: Its coordinates are disqualified as placement, though its structural conventions such as zone kinds and reserved circulation may still be reused
criteria.fully_usable: It is a valid wheel and its coordinates can be reused directly
